item.title: LibreNotebook
item.description: LibreNotebook is Enoch Yu’s giant and free personal notebook. The purpose is to inspire and accelerate open education as a way of returning the blessings that I received from public educational resources.

item.title: Problem of the Day: 100 Problems for 100 Days
item.description: As the name suggests, “Problem of the Day: 100 Problem for 100 Days” solves 100 olympiad problems from diverse sources. The problems are mixed with hard and easier problems with sources varying from famous olympiads to original problems. The links to the handwritten PDF files and video solutions for each problem can be found in the overview PDF below.

item.title: Enoch's Notebook: An Introduction to Linear Algebra
item.description: Linear algebra is a foundational branch of mathematics that primarily investigates in linear equations, vectors, and their relations. The application of linear algebra is so immense that numerous fields require foundational understanding of linear algebra. For instance, it would not be possible to gain profound understandings in machine learning and data science without the basics of linear algebra. This collection of notes discuss the essence of linear algebra in perspective of teaching.

item.title: We are here!
item.description:
Hi there! As the initial post, I hope to provide a glimpse on what we have been doing so far and few improvements that will be made as we progress.

After the initialization and formalizing our purpose and goals, I have been making and designing this website. There are improvements to be made in the website, but we hope to get them as we progress. With the empty website, I have been adding the resources that I have created and that I am working on right now as the initial start. We also have been sharing our ideas and the purpose of Nanum Learn with others to receive feedback and improve. These are the works that have been done so far before the initial release.
